I replied to Ilse in her #north-random thread to say I'd noted the correction: the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 10 June. My reply says "I've noted," but there's no separate record. The reply itself is the only note.

She said no action was needed, so I didn't change anything else. I didn't read #north-team or mention the wrong date from her earlier post. The renewal date is an operational fact, not a finance figure, and she had already posted it in #north-random herself, so repeating it there was fine.
